description: Defines enums, structs, and classes related to PDSCH rate matching patterns in 5G NR, including pattern IDs, symbol bitmaps, periodicity, and pattern types.

classes.name: rate_match_pattern::symbols_in_rb
classes.description: Represents symbol-level bitmap in time domain for resource blocks, with support for one or two slot patterns.

classes.name: rate_match_pattern::periodicity_and_pattern
classes.description: Represents the periodicity and pattern for rate matching, supporting multiple periodicity types.

classes.name: rate_match_pattern::bitmaps
classes.description: Defines resource block level bitmaps and associated symbol and pattern information for rate matching.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for symbols_in_rb, periodicity_and_pattern, bitmaps, and rate_match_pattern structs.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality operator for symbols_in_rb, periodicity_and_pattern, bitmaps, and rate_match_pattern structs.
